lessons.symptom: A slideshow was substituted for a motion reference.
lessons.root_cause: Reference dynamics were not used as an acceptance constraint.
lessons.fix: Inspect dense reference frames and actual changing source; separate subject motion from camera-only zoom.
lessons.evidence: Reported prior V3 rejection + current reference/V2/V4 inspection

lessons.symptom: An earlier V3 master reportedly used yuv444p and did not play.
lessons.root_cause: Encoder pixel format was not explicitly constrained.
lessons.fix: H264 High/yuv420p + AAC + faststart; full decode; download fallback while Drive transcodes.
lessons.evidence: Prior transcript report; actual V5/V6 codec checks

lessons.symptom: V4 left English, Instagram tags/end-card and tiny Urdu text.
lessons.root_cause: Audio replacement plus tiny overlay was treated as localization.
lessons.fix: Clean source typography/tags; rebuild readable integrated titles; replace closing card.

lessons.symptom: Global speed-up forced the dub into the English video timing.
lessons.root_cause: Picture duration was treated as fixed instead of honoring spoken phrasing.
lessons.fix: Restore selected nine clips; trim quiet only; recut each semantic shot to natural 1.0x speech.
lessons.regression: Original voice hash and pace gates

lessons.symptom: Large Telea patches made cloudy paper areas.
lessons.root_cause: Large opaque masks and restoration method interacted badly with grain/gradient.
lessons.fix: Use shot-aware glyph masks and Navier–Stokes inpainting; inspect texture, not just text absence.
lessons.regression: Texture inspection; no claim of perfect restoration

lessons.symptom: Color-key/background replacement damaged hair, bulbs and thin supports.
lessons.root_cause: Pale foreground resembled the lavender background.
lessons.fix: Reject destructive keyed matte; retain full changing footage and use non-destructive near/far maps.
lessons.regression: Silhouette, hair, strings, shoes and highlight review

lessons.symptom: Masking both possible Instagram positions cut the talent stone.
lessons.root_cause: Tag placement was assumed instead of detected.
lessons.fix: Template-match the actually active icon corner; erase its handle only.
lessons.evidence: Observed V5 repair; match scores approximately 0.85–0.997 vs empty 0.10–0.21

lessons.symptom: Animated headings moved outside static text masks; early 1915 strokes survived.
lessons.root_cause: A single settled-frame rectangle was used across entry animation.
lessons.fix: Use time-dependent regions and inspect entry/exit frames, not just shot midpoint.

lessons.symptom: Broad early lower masks cut shoes; a later ramp missed top letter strokes.
lessons.root_cause: Mask timing ignored the runner’s abrupt rise before the lower title entered.
lessons.fix: Protect early low shoes; clean the full lower title after source t>=25.70s in this case.
lessons.evidence: Observed V5/V6 fixes; four V6 runner samples 32.10/32.23/32.35/32.46s
lessons.regression: Case-specific threshold, not a universal rule

lessons.symptom: Approximate source boundaries showed the next subject under the wrong sentence.
lessons.root_cause: Sparse sampling was mistaken for exact cuts.
lessons.fix: Densely inspect cuts; measured source watch end 14.97s and flow end 21.03s.

lessons.symptom: Purple sandbag was classified as title ink.
lessons.root_cause: Color alone cannot distinguish a prop from typography.
lessons.fix: Protect the large connected subject component; apply masks only in intended zones.

lessons.symptom: Completed ignored MP4/runtime/dependency cache disappeared before upload.
lessons.root_cause: Receipts persisted but ignored media bytes did not.
lessons.fix: Protect a bounded pending-upload spool; verify cloud copies before returning media to ignored storage.
lessons.evidence: Actual workspace reset; V5 recovered byte-identically

lessons.symptom: A parallel log said presented although present_file failed.
lessons.root_cause: Intent was logged before tool success.
lessons.fix: Record presentation only after success; correct the journal on failed presentation.

lessons.symptom: V6 process-log stream disconnected after stages had completed.
lessons.root_cause: Transport status can differ from process/artifact status.
lessons.fix: Inspect process, PIPELINE_STATE, file and QA before any restart.
lessons.evidence: Actual V6 stream error; filesystem proved exit 0

lessons.symptom: Marking checkpoint status completed before CLI complete blocked archive.
lessons.root_cause: complete requires an active task in the legacy controller.
lessons.fix: Archive via complete while active; add regression protection for completed checkpoints.
lessons.evidence: Actual V5 archive workaround; V6 normal completion

lessons.failure: Technical pass is not style approval
lessons.symptom: V6 passed technical checks but user rejected its lower caption pills.
lessons.root_cause: Readability metrics did not encode the preferred editorial hierarchy.
lessons.fix: Latest feedback overrides experiments: integrated clean type default, no pill/word strip; keep originals as history.

lessons.symptom: Ignored virtualenv binaries and a CA certificate were scanned as repository files.
lessons.root_cause: Filesystem enumeration did not honor ignored dependency caches.
lessons.fix: Validate commit-eligible files and tracked exceptions; preserve sparse-checkout behavior.

lessons.symptom: Early scratch states/full pre-init conversation or V1–V3 editable sources were not all recoverable.
lessons.root_cause: Compacted chat and delivered filenames are not complete source archives.
lessons.fix: Separate observed/reported/proposed facts; preserve available raw source and explicitly inventory gaps.
